_note: logoUrl: OPTIONAL override for the PDF logo. Leave empty and the tool reads the src of the element HireHop already renders in every page header - each company's logo is at /uploads_img/{COMPANY_ID}_{hash}.png where the hash varies per upload, so we grab it live off the DOM. Set logoUrl only for a custom image. For external URLs, the host must send CORS headers; SVGs need intrinsic width/height. logoBox = max width/height in mm; image fitted preserving aspect ratio.
_features_note: features.pdfSavePrompt.companyIds is a whitelist of HireHop numeric user.COMPANY_IDs that get the local Save-As prompt when they Add a stage kit. All other companies still get the PDF auto-uploaded to the Files tab but skip the interactive save dialog. Empty list = feature off for everyone. Current: 5949=YES Events, 8109=YES Demo (both opted in). 3198=Wise (opted out - Files-tab upload only).
